bibl.title: Hipponax’s Strasbourg Epode
bibl.seg: Enrico Emanuele Prodi, Hipponax's Strasbourg Epode.
bibl.note: A kollesis is strong evidence that the two fragments of P. Stras. Inv. 3 (Hipponax, frr. *115-*117 W.) belong to the same column. Argues for placing fr. B first and reading frr. *117 and *115 W. as belonging to the same poem.
